ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.17.1 is the first compatibility hotfix for the bounded-risk parallel Work prefilter. It retains the V0.4.17 GrowerSow, GrowerHarvest and BuildRoof architecture while adding exact source-reviewed coexistence for the user's large mod environment: Humanoid Alien Races harvest restrictions may remain as downstream true-to-false authority, while Biomes! Core sowing runs in a restricted mode where worker OutOfGrowthSeason negatives always fall back to live Vanilla so Biomes' shared per-plant season context is never reproduced off-thread. Watchtowers BuildRoof remains fail-closed pending source review. Workers still never create Jobs, reserve targets or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map state. V0.4.16 aggressive Reachability, full CanReach Harmony census, persistent map search, hauling accelerators, path shadow validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
